fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. The planner read ship-main-tree-check, shipCheckMainTree/runShipMerge/shipRerunFailed in internal/api/ship.go, ship-change.toml's wait-main and main-green steps, .github/workflows/ci.yml, the ci install template and the stopped run's error (merge commit b9229f0 tree 6b107af vs tested head ab3969c tree 0e2c59e). It found that GitHub's workflow_dispatch takes only a branch or tag ref, so `--ref <sha>` cannot pin the merge commit, that ship-change is generic across repos, and that ci.yml's concurrency group keys on the PR number (empty on a dispatch). It raised four choices to the arbiter: the intent served, which commit a dispatched run tests, which workflows to dispatch, and what a failed dispatched run does. The arbiter ruled (Decision ship-main-dispatch-ci): serve milestone-25; dispatch with --ref main and a required sha input the workflow checks out, its run-name carrying the sha so ship finds its run; dispatch every workflow declaring both pull_request and workflow_dispatch, stopping when none exists; rerun failed jobs once, then stop for a person. The planner then revised the three capabilities #256 built (ship-main-tree-check, ci-yml-cancels-stale, ci-install-cancels-stale) to carry the dispatch path, including runs resumed from before #256.
fields.title: Plan of Fix Ship's new main-tree check (autonomous, arbiter)
